title: Olympus Homeowners Policy HO-2026 - Section I Exclusions
content: Water Damage Exclusion. We do not insure loss caused directly or indirectly by flood, surface water, waves, tidal water, overflow of a body of water, storm surge, or water below the surface of the ground which presses on, flows, seeps, or leaks through a building, foundation, swimming pool, or other structure. We also do not insure repeated or continuous seepage or leakage of water or steam occurring over a period of 14 days or more. Water or water-borne material that backs up through sewers or drains, or overflows or is discharged from a sump, sump pump, or related equipment, is excluded unless the Water Backup endorsement is shown in the Declarations.

title: Olympus Homeowners Policy HO-2026 - Section I Perils Insured Against
content: Subject to the policy exclusions and applicable deductible, we insure sudden and accidental direct physical loss caused by the discharge or overflow of water or steam from within a plumbing, heating, air-conditioning, or automatic fire-protective sprinkler system, or from within a household appliance. We also cover the reasonable cost to tear out and replace only the part of the building necessary to access and repair the system or appliance from which the water escaped. We do not cover the system or appliance that caused the loss.

title: Olympus Homeowners Water Loss Claims Guide
content: For a reported water loss, record when the damage was first observed, the apparent source, how long the condition may have existed, and any mitigation already performed. Ask the policyholder to prevent further damage where safe, retain damaged property when practical, and provide photographs, plumber or remediation reports, and invoices. Coverage must be assessed against the issued policy form, endorsements, cause of loss, duration, and applicable deductible.
